title: D Major — Two Sharps
body: D major has two sharps: F# and C#. Adding a second sharp always targets the 7th note of the new scale. The pattern: each new sharp key adds one more sharp to the 7th.

title: F# and C# in Action
caption: Compare F# here to the F natural you played in C major — it's one white key higher. C# is similarly raised from C. The rest of the notes are identical to C major.
